'''Elav Feen''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who owned the popular spacer bar [[The Swirling Vortex]].<ref name="University" />

He had a number of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] associates, who were being plagued by a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Jizal Taphan]].<ref name="University" />
